title: Crocs, Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2026
excerpt: As of June 30, 2026, we were in compliance with all financial covenants under the Credit Agreement.
summary: The Q2 2026 Form 10-Q confirms Crocs, Inc.'s Nasdaq common-stock identity and reports USD 1.179 billion quarterly revenue, USD 285.7 million operating income, USD 204.9 million net income, 48.1 million period-end shares, USD 170.3 million cash, USD 1.308 billion long-term borrowings, and USD 270.8 million first-half operating cash flow. It details HEYDUDE impairment history, secured debt, repurchase restrictions, inventory, demand, foreign-exchange, sourcing and execution risks.
